HOME.SUBTITLE: Whispr is the ultimate platform to find out what your friends really think about you. Share your unique link on your social networks and read their secret replies in your private inbox.
HOME.FEATURE1_DESC: Your data is encrypted and hateful messages are blocked by our AI before they reach you.
HOME.FEATURE2_DESC: Change colors, your bio, and the displayed question to create a page that reflects you.
HOME.FEATURE3_DESC: Share the messages you receive directly to your Instagram, Snapchat or TikTok stories in one click.
HOME.AI_SAFE_DESC: We trained our Artificial Intelligence to instantly detect and block harassment, threats, and toxic language. Receive honest messages, without the negativity.
HOME.TESTIMONIAL1_TEXT: Finally an app where I can receive honest feedback without fear of trolls. The AI works perfectly!
HOME.TESTIMONIAL2_TEXT: I put it in my Insta story and received so many cute messages 🥺 Customizing the page is a huge plus.
HOME.TESTIMONIAL3_TEXT: The interface is super clean, smooth, and above all, it's 100% anonymous. Highly recommended.
HOME.BOTTOM_CTA_TITLE: Ready to discover what they think about you?
HOME.STEP1_DESC: Sign up in seconds and get your personal link like whispr.com/pseudo.
HOME.STEP2_DESC: Add your link to your Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat or Twitter bio so your followers can see it.
HOME.STEP3_DESC: Receive totally anonymous messages. Our AI automatically filters out hateful content.
HOME.FAQ1_A: Yes. Unlike other apps that keep IP addresses in clear text, Whispr uses cryptographic hashing algorithms to pseudonymize all connection data.
HOME.FAQ2_A: All incoming messages are analyzed in real time by our artificial intelligence before they even reach your inbox. Toxic messages are automatically filtered or flagged.
